title: No way to add a tool API key at run time
problem: Tools read their API keys from the pod environment privately. Nothing in the product said which tools needed a key, and the only instructions were kubectl and helm commands. An admin could not add a key from the UI.
fix: Tools declare the values they need as config_fields and read them through one resolver. Admin -> Tool Configuration is generated from those declarations, saves values encrypted at rest and agents pick them up within 30 seconds. A lint in CI fails any tool that reads the environment privately.

title: A missing or rejected tool key produced four different behaviours
problem: Depending on the tool, a missing key returned an error, an empty list, a generic failure or a made-up reason. A key the provider rejected was swallowed and read as no results.
fix: One standard result names the key and the admin screen. A rejected key is an error with the provider's status. Tools that run with fewer sources say which they skipped and the model sees that note.

title: Flight Recorder showed tool calls without results or real durations
problem: Tool results were never persisted on the execution row, durations were an even split of the total, the pipeline node table never rendered and replay returned no steps.
fix: Every path persists each tool call's result, error flag and measured duration. Pipelines store their nodes as a list of steps and the recorder has a step replay panel.

title: Timed out and errored runs were saved as completed
problem: A run that hit its time budget or raised during streaming ended with status completed, and a client that disconnected left the row running forever.
fix: Those runs are failed with a failure code, and an abandoned stream closes its row.

title: human_approval gates were invisible on the Approvals page
problem: In-run approval gates lived in Redis while the Approvals page read the database, so an approver never saw them. The stale-run sweeper also failed runs that were legitimately waiting.
fix: Gates are listed and approvable on /approvals, decisions write a history row, and the sweeper skips runs that are waiting on a gate.

title: Nothing enforced that an agent called its required tools
problem: An agent told to always use a tool could answer without it and the run still completed.
fix: model_config.require_tools fails such a run with REQUIRED_TOOLS_VIOLATION. A run that calls no tool at all while having some is flagged.

title: Seeded pipeline ignored what the user typed
problem: Input variables from the chat page never reached the pipeline context, so the repository analyzer always analysed the default repository.
fix: Input variable defaults apply to the context and the chat page sends typed values as context.

title: Knowledge base bound at creation was not readable by the agent
problem: Creating a knowledge base with an agent id did not grant that agent access, so knowledge_search returned nothing.
fix: Creating or updating a knowledge base with an agent grants read access, and a seed backfills older ones.

title: Model pricing catalogue empty on a fresh install
problem: Spend showed zero because no pricing rows were seeded.
fix: The pricing baseline is seeded on every deploy.

title: Marketplace exposed unpublished agents across tenants
problem: The marketplace detail and subscribe endpoints accepted any active agent and returned its system prompt and full configuration to users in other tenants.
fix: Only published listings are reachable, the public payload is an allow-list, and reading, exporting or running an agent follows one access rule.

title: Generated tools could escape their sandbox
problem: Tool code written by an agent at run time ran in-process with introspection builtins and pandas available, so it could reach the environment and the filesystem.
fix: A restricted set of pure modules, no dunder access, a wall-clock timeout and a capped result. An unknown pipeline tool fails instead of having code generated for it.

title: MCP credentials reached the runtime still encrypted
problem: The runtime sent ciphertext as the bearer token, auth failed and the agent silently ran without its MCP tools.
fix: Credentials are decrypted for the runtime, a server that is down is reported to the model, and MCP tools work on queued runs too.

title: Playground runs inherited the API pod's secrets
problem: User code in the SDK and load-test playgrounds ran with the API pod's full environment, including database and provider credentials.
fix: Runs get a minimal environment and the key minted for a run is revoked when it ends.

title: Archives were global across tenants
problem: Any tenant admin could archive, delete and download every tenant's executions.
fix: Archive runs and retention policies are scoped to a tenant and deletes follow dependency order.

title: Tenant Slack webhooks stored in plain text and leaked to the operator channel
problem: Webhook URLs were plain text and returned to every member, and tenants without one fell back to the operator's channel.
fix: Webhooks and approval secrets are encrypted and masked, and the fallback is gone. The Test Slack button works again.

title: Failed runs never reached the dead-letter queue
problem: Nothing wrote to the DLQ, and replay lost the pool and pipeline flag and never linked to the original run.
fix: Failed runs are written to the DLQ and replay keeps pool, pipeline flag and input and links to the original.

title: Scheduled triggers fired once per API replica
problem: Due triggers were read without a lock, so three replicas fired the same schedule three times.
fix: Due triggers are claimed with a row lock and runs are queued instead of kept in the API process.

title: Drift on cost, confidence and failure rate could never alert
problem: An absolute noise floor of 1.0 made small-range metrics unable to cross two sigma, and the baseline was frozen after ten runs.
fix: A relative noise floor per metric and a rolling baseline.

title: Pipeline Surgeon patches targeted the wrong config paths
problem: The prompt and the config shape disagreed, the tool list sent to the Surgeon was always empty and patches were applied without validation or audit.
fix: Paths match the real shape, patches go through an allow-list validator and a compare-and-swap, and every apply or rollback is audited.

title: Response moderation skipped on streamed chat
problem: The post-LLM gate only ran on non-streamed runs, so a redact or block policy on responses had no effect in chat.
fix: The gate runs on the streamed answer, the chat swaps in the redacted text and shows a moderation notice.

title: Polling clients saw dropped connections every few seconds
problem: uvicorn closed idle keep-alive connections after 5 seconds, which raced clients that poll on a reused connection.
fix: The API runs with a 75 second keep-alive.

title: Rejected LLM credentials reported as a cluster RBAC failure
problem: A revoked subscription token showed as INFRA_AUTH_ERROR, pointing operators at service-account permissions.
fix: Classified as LLM_AUTH_ERROR with a hint to re-sync the token or fix the key.
